project_info: AI Market Pulse Dashboard is a comprehensive analytics platform that provides real-time market insights and AI-powered analysis. The project was initiated in 2025 to help businesses make data-driven decisions.
welcome_message: Welcome to AI Market Pulse Dashboard - Your intelligent market analysis assistant!

about.purpose: AI Market Pulse Dashboard helps you track and analyze financial markets with AI-powered insights and real-time data visualization.
key_features: Real-time market data for stocks and cryptocurrencies

how_to_use: 1. **Explore Markets**: Browse different market sections using the navigation menu
2. **Search Assets**: Use the search bar to find specific stocks or cryptocurrencies
3. **View Analysis**: Click on any asset to see detailed analysis and charts
4. **Get Insights**: Check the AI-powered insights section for market predictions
5. **Customize**: Create watchlists and set up alerts for price movements

faq.What data sources do you use?: We use multiple reliable financial data providers and real-time APIs to ensure accurate market data.
faq.How often is the data updated?: Market data is updated in real-time during market hours with 15-minute delayed data for free accounts.
faq.Are there any subscription plans?: We offer both free and premium plans. Premium features include real-time data, advanced analytics, and more.
faq.How accurate are the AI predictions?: Our AI models are trained on historical data and have shown an average accuracy of 75-85% in backtesting. However, past performance is not indicative of future results.
faq.Can I track my portfolio?: Yes, you can create and track multiple portfolios with our portfolio management tools.

getting_help.feedback: We'd love to hear your feedback! Use the feedback button in the app.
